scientific.integrity: All sign claims follow from the source's own equilibrium equation and positive-parameter assumptions. The primary PDF was inspected at the model, equilibrium, and stability-proof passages, and the symbolic checker reproduces the algebra exactly.
limitations: The result proves that condition (4.16) is infeasible for a strictly positive equilibrium and that the stated Lyapunov proof of Theorem 6 is invalid as written; it does not prove that the Routh–Hurwitz criterion (4.15) is false or that Theorem 6 has no alternative proof.
No claim is made about the Hopf-bifurcation computations or numerical diagrams except where they rely on the invalidated sufficient-stability argument.

title: An equilibrium balance invalidates two published stability arguments
